eras.title: Steps into a vanished building
eras.caption: At Anuradhapura, a carved moonstone lies at the foot of a stairway whose upper building has disappeared. Guardstones and surviving foundations reveal the care given to entrances in the monastic complexes of Sri Lanka's ancient capital.
